lines: Energy-feasible UAV exploration over an online registry of safe landing zones
Demonstration missions: PX4 SITL, Gazebo Harmonic, ROS 2, shown in RViz
Each flight is shown next to its own energy margin, drawn from the mission log
Dorian Veloso, Capstone B, University of Technology Sydney, 2026
Reading the picture
Cells: green landable, light green too close to a refused cell, red refused (slope, roughness, step), grey not yet judged
Zones of the registry: yellow candidate, green confirmed, blue the take-off point
Frontiers: cyan admissible, red rejected by C1, blue the target chosen by C2; blue line: the path
Right: energy left (blue) against what the return and landing need plus the reserve (black); the gap is the margin
Filmed missions are demonstrations: rendering slows the simulation, so they are charged more energy than the measured ones
